note: Every production surface that receives a runtime object requires a MINT-ONLY, mechanically verifiable binding.  This matrix records which binding each surface enforces, what the production code recomputes, and which round commit closed it.  All contract flags are implemented and pinned by the dedicated C18 tests; none of them claim real execution (all REAL_* flags remain false).

bindings.surface: frozen formal asset registry (production archive write path)
bindings.binding: DiscoveryProvenanceRegistry resolved ONLY from the controller injection slot; usage must be PRODUCTION; registry_hash recomputed
bindings.recomputed: registry_hash_of over forbidden/allowed identity sets + usage
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: TEST_ONLY registries, caller-supplied Mappings, re-injection without clear

bindings.binding: VerifiedRestoreContext minted ONLY from an accepted fresh-process outcome + mechanically verified process evidence + the injection slot
bindings.recomputed: production_joint_pass, context_hash over the dataclass fields (to_payload-free)
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: plain Mappings, self-reported production_joint_pass, tampered fields, synthetic evidence

bindings.binding: encode_env_state forwards policy_memory / history_reference into the encoded bundle; per-bundle fresh, never shared
bindings.recomputed: bundle round-trip through StateCodec; mode-conditional presence re-verified by the guard chain
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: omitted memory (fields stay empty and the write is refused), shared memory objects

bindings.binding: every branch re-restores its OWN state and compares against the verified context state hash
bindings.recomputed: per-branch start digest equality with the first branch; payload hash re-decoded
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: partial actual-N, wrong-state branch starts, identity substitution

bindings.binding: Reference branches consume ONLY the Reference memory surface; identity/checkpoint/memory spec bound from construction
bindings.recomputed: reference identity hash == executing policy identity; Reference artifact spec/identity hashes
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: Student memory substituted into Reference branches, anonymous References

bindings.binding: per-source Wilson estimates; frontier classification from STUDENT branches only
bindings.recomputed: per-source success rates and CIs; never pooled into one rate

bindings.binding: SelectionEvidence mint-only; every measured quantity recomputed inside the minter; evidence_hash derived
bindings.recomputed: rates, per-source counts, gap, uncertainty, transition cost, evidence_hash
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: unsigned evidence, tampered evidence, arbitrary Mappings, priority_score surfaces

bindings.binding: AuthorizedTwoLLMRuntime = mint-only TwoLLMAuthorization + hash-chained CallJournal; ceiling exactly 2
bindings.recomputed: authorization_hash; journal chain from JOURNAL_CHAIN_SEED; role order
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: bare client factories, FakeLLMClient fallback, more than two calls, out-of-order roles

bindings.binding: derive_invocation_from_evidence from measured evidence change; previous plan re-verified before reuse
bindings.recomputed: current evidence hash vs previous plan's bound hash; actual_n/horizon/memory_mode freshness

bindings.binding: compile_planner_to_frontier_distributions: deterministic function of the typed PlannerOutput + minted selection evidence
bindings.recomputed: plan_hash re-bound to plan_evidence_hash; selection evidence verified; every state validated against the archive; single measured bucket per slot; compilation_hash
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: caller-supplied distribution lists, hand-built Mappings, ZERO_MEMORY, empty distribution fields

bindings.binding: resolve_distribution_binding consumes seed/stochasticity/taskparams into an immutable per-episode binding
bindings.recomputed: episode_seed (canonical sha256), epsilon/temperature from stochasticity_range, taskparams pass-through, binding_hash
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: empty/unknown/out-of-range distribution fields, Mappings, shared window memory

bindings.binding: OriginalTrainingRuntime minted from the injected loss/update callables; per-callable source file+text hash; runtime_hash
bindings.recomputed: current source hashes of stored callables + runtime hash (substitution/tamper detection)
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: plain callables, source-less builtins, Mapping loss, substituted callables

bindings.binding: OptimizerUpdateAttestation minted from pipeline-measured facts (before/after params hashes, loaded-state step baseline, structural finiteness, batch digest)
bindings.recomputed: batch digest over the exact arrays; step increment before+1; params_changed/finite invariants
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: self-reported update_count / grad_norm, bit-identical updates, non-finite params, unmeasurable step baseline

bindings.binding: CheckpointRoundTripEvidence requires full state (params+step) survival AND exact replay equivalence (action/logits/value/new-memory)
bindings.recomputed: params hashes, global step, replay equivalence on one identical deterministic step; evidence_hash
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: params-only comparison, action-range-only replay, lossy round trips, missing logits

bindings.binding: TrainingSurfaceCapability signed descriptor verified, bound to the MOUNTED adapter identity, non-synthetic signature
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: exception-inference probes (deleted), self-signed descriptors, foreign-identity descriptors

bindings.binding: signed runtime bundle manifest (exact-key, per-file exist + sha256, non-synthetic signatures) is the ONLY injection channel
bindings.recomputed: referenced file sha256; registry/restore/anchor payloads rebuilt and re-verified; capability minted against the mounted identity
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: env-var guessing, ad-hoc overrides, missing/null channels, TEST_ONLY registry payloads

bindings.binding: evaluate_launch_blockers from real preflight report, Reference/anchor designation state, director-signed LongRunBudgetDecision, audit approval
bindings.recomputed: budget decision hash + payload schema; cross-bound total_env_steps == frozen TOTAL_ENV_STEPS
bindings.fake_surfaces_rejected: hardcoded blocker lists, assumed budget semantics, self-signed decisions
